field.label: Google Tag ID
field.comment: Register here and get the tag ID. E.g: GTM-XXXXXX

field.label: GA4 Measurement ID
field.comment: Register here and get the tag Measurement ID inside data stream section. E.g: G-XXXXXXXXXX

field.label: Brand Attribute
field.comment: Product attribute code sent as item_brand in every event, e.g. manufacturer. Empty = no brand. For category/search listings set the attribute's Used in Product Listing to Yes, otherwise listings send no brand.

field.label: Affiliation
field.comment: Sent as affiliation on every item (client and server side), e.g. your store name. Useful to tell several stores apart in one GA4 property. Empty = not sent.

field.label: Allow dataLayer Debug Logging
field.comment: When Yes, open any storefront page with ?gtm_debug=1 to log every dataLayer push (events, consent commands) to the browser console in that browser; ?gtm_debug=0 switches it off. Other visitors see nothing. Turn off in production when not needed.

field.label: Custom GTM Script URL
field.comment: Optional. Load gtm.js from a first-party or server-side GTM domain instead of https://www.googletagmanager.com, e.g. https://gtm.example.com. Domain only: HTTPS, an optional port, no path; anything else is rejected on save. The host is added to the Content Security Policy automatically. See README, "Custom GTM script URL".

field.label: Don't Track Customer Groups
field.comment: Visitors in these groups (e.g. staff, wholesale) get no GTM and no events, and their orders are not sent server-side. Ctrl/Cmd-click to deselect.

field.label: Maximum Transaction Value
field.comment: Orders with a grand total above this amount (base currency) are not tracked as purchases, client or server side, e.g. test orders. Empty or 0 = no maximum.

field.label: view_cart When the Minicart Opens
field.comment: Also push view_cart every time the visitor opens Hyvä's cart drawer (the cart page always sends it).

field.label: Category Depth
field.comment: How many category levels are sent (item_category … item_category5), from the top level down.

field.label: Excluded Categories
field.comment: Comma-separated category IDs never sent as item categories, e.g. "Sale" or "New" (the next level moves up). See Catalog > Categories for the IDs.

field.label: Custom Item Parameters
field.comment: Up to five parameter_name:attribute_code pairs, one per line, e.g. item_color:color. Sent on every item, client and server side. Register them in GA4 as item-scoped custom dimensions. See README, "Custom item parameters".

field.label: Exclude Zero-value Orders
field.comment: Orders with a grand total of 0 (100 % coupons, free samples) are not tracked as purchases: no client-side purchase event on the success page and no server-side purchase_server.

group.label: Cookie Consent
group.comment: How the module knows that the visitor accepted tracking. GTM is loaded, and the server-side purchase uses the visitor's GA identifiers, only after consent. Works with Magento's own cookie (Hyvä's built-in banner, enabled by General > Web > Default Cookie Settings > Cookie Restriction Mode) or with any other banner via a cookie name and/or a browser event.

field.label: Require Consent
field.comment: No = GTM always loads and server-side events always use the visitor's identifiers. Only for stores where tracking needs no consent.

field.label: Consent Cookie Name
field.comment: Cookie written by the banner when the visitor accepts. Default user_allowed_save_cookie (Magento / Hyvä banner, value {"websiteId":1}). Leave empty if the banner only fires a browser event; the server then cannot see consent and uses When Consent Cannot Be Determined.

field.label: Cookie Value Meaning "Accepted"
field.comment: Optional text the cookie must contain, e.g. statistics:true for Cookiebot's CookieConsent cookie. Empty = automatic: a JSON map needs a truthy entry for the current website ID, a plain value must be 1, true, yes, granted, accepted or allow.

field.label: Consent Event Names (fallback)
field.comment: Comma-separated browser (window) events that mean "accepted", for banners that announce consent with an event. Default user-allowed-save-cookie (Hyvä's built-in banner). When the event fires, GTM loads on that page unless the consent cookie is present and says "declined". Event-only banners must fire the event on every page load.

field.label: Google Consent Mode v2
field.comment: Off: GTM loads only after consent, no consent signals (original behaviour). Basic: same, plus "denied" defaults before and "granted" signals after consent. Advanced: GTM loads at once with everything "denied" (Google sends cookieless pings and models declined visitors), "granted" after consent; check with your privacy adviser first. Details: README, section "Google Consent Mode v2".

field.label: Signals Granted on Consent
field.comment: All four signals, or only analytics_storage (ads signals stay "denied", for stores without Google Ads). See README.

field.label: Banner Sends Consent Mode Signals
field.comment: Yes if your banner (Cookiebot, OneTrust, Usercentrics, ...) sets Consent Mode itself: the module then sends no consent commands and only decides when GTM loads. See README.

group.label: Server-side Purchase Tracking (Measurement Protocol)
group.comment: Sends a second purchase event (purchase_server by default) from Magento to GA4 when an order is placed, independent of the browser. It is a comparison signal to see how many orders client-side tracking misses; it is not counted as revenue in standard GA4 reports. Requires cron.

field.label: Measurement ID
field.comment: Leave empty to use the GA4 Measurement ID from the General group. Must belong to the same data stream as the API secret.

field.label: API Secret
field.comment: Analytics > Admin > Data streams > your stream > Measurement Protocol API secrets > Create.

field.label: Event Name
field.comment: Default: purchase_server. Letters, digits and underscores; must start with a letter. Do not use purchase, that is the client-side event.

field.label: Tax in Totals
field.comment: Only affects value. Including: the order grand total, like the client-side purchase event. Excluding: grand total minus tax. Item prices and shipping are always without tax and tax is always sent separately, exactly like the client-side purchase event.

field.label: Item ID for Configurable Products
field.comment: Which SKU is sent as item_id for configurable products. Applies to all events (client-side cart, checkout and purchase events and the server-side purchase and refunds), so one product is one GA4 item everywhere. Bundles always send the bundle's own SKU; other product types their own SKU. The variant options are sent as item_variant either way.

field.label: When Consent Cannot Be Determined
field.comment: Admin-created orders and orders placed by payment-gateway callbacks have no visitor cookies. Orders from visitors who declined tracking cookies are never sent.

field.label: Track Refunds
field.comment: Sends one event per credit memo (refunded value and items), only for orders whose purchase was sent server-side.

field.label: Refund Event Name
field.comment: Default: refund_server. A comparison signal like purchase_server, not GA4's standard refund.

field.label: Track Cancellations
field.comment: Sends one event with the order total when an order is cancelled, only for orders whose purchase was sent server-side.

field.label: Cancellation Event Name
field.comment: Default: cancel_server.

field.label: Maximum Send Attempts
field.comment: Failed sends are retried with growing delays (1 min, 2, 4, ... up to 6 h) until this limit.

field.label: Debug Mode
field.comment: Sends to Google's validation endpoint instead and logs the result in var/log. Nothing is recorded in GA4 while this is on and queued orders are closed as sent. Turn off after testing.

field.label: Show in GA4 DebugView
field.comment: Adds debug_mode so server-side events appear in Analytics > Admin > DebugView. Unlike Debug Mode, events are really sent and recorded. Turn off after testing.

field.label: Keep Sent/Skipped Rows (days)
field.comment: Older sent and skipped rows are deleted daily. Failed and expired rows are always kept. 0 = keep forever.

field.button_label: Export JSON file for GoogleTagManager generating tags, triggers and variables
